verses.en: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.fr: Paul, serviteur de Dieu, et apôtre de Jésus-Christ pour la foi des élus de Dieu et la connaissance de la vérité qui est selon la piété,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያና የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥

verses.en: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.fr: lesquelles reposent sur l''espérance de la vie éternelle, promise dès les plus anciens temps par le Dieu qui ne ment point,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ለተመረጡት እምነት እንዲሆንላቸው በዘላለምም ሕይወት ተስፋ እንደ አምልኮት ያለውን እውነት እንዲያውቁ የተላከ፤ ስለዚህም ሕይወት የማይዋሽ እግዚአብሔር ከዘላለም ዘመናት በፊት ተስፋ ሰጠ፥

verses.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.fr: et qui a manifesté sa parole en son temps par la prédication qui m''a été confiée d''après l''ordre de Dieu notre Sauveur,
verses.am: በዘመኑም ጊዜ፥ መድኃኒታችን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ፥ ለእኔ አደራ በተሰጠኝ ስብከት ቃሉን ገለጠ፤

verses.en: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
verses.fr: Tite, mon enfant légitime en notre commune foi: que la grâce et la paix te soient données de la part de Dieu le Père et de Jésus-Christ notre Sauveur!
verses.am: በሃይማኖት ኅብረት እውነተኛ ልጄ ለሚሆን ለቲቶ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ከመድኃኒታችንም ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

verses.en: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
verses.fr: Je t''ai laissé en Crète, afin que tu mettes en ordre ce qui reste à régler, et que, selon mes instructions, tu établisses des anciens dans chaque ville,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምክንያት የቀረውን እንድታደራጅ በየከተማውም፥ እኔ አንተን እንዳዘዝሁ፥ ሽማግሌዎችን እንድትሾም በቀርጤስ ተውሁህ፤

verses.en: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.fr: s''il s''y trouve quelque homme irréprochable, mari d''une seule femme, ayant des enfants fidèles, qui ne soient ni accusés de débauche ni rebelles.
verses.am: የማይነቀፍና የአንዲት ሚስት ባል የሚሆን፥ የሚያምኑም ልጆች ያሉት፥ ስለ መዳራትም ወይም ስለ አለመታዘዝ የማይከሰስ ማንም ቢኖር፥ ሹመው።

verses.en: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.fr: Car il faut que l''évêque soit irréprochable, comme économe de Dieu; qu''il ne soit ni arrogant, ni colère, ni adonné au vin, ni violent, ni porté à un gain déshonnête;
verses.am: ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢ፥ የማይነቀፍ ሊሆን ይገባዋልና፤ የማይኮራ፥ የማይቆጣ፥ የማይሰክር፥ የማይጨቃጨቅ፥ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይወድ፥

verses.en: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.fr: mais qu''il soit hospitalier, ami des gens de bien, modéré, juste, saint, tempérant,
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንግዳ ተቀባይ፥ በጎ የሆነውን ነገር የሚወድ፥ ጠንቃቃ፥ ጻድቅ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ራሱን የሚገዛ ይሁን፤

verses.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.fr: attaché à la vraie parole telle qu''elle a été enseignée, afin d''être capable d''exhorter selon la saine doctrine et de réfuter les contradicteurs.
verses.am: ሕይወት በሚገኝበት ትምህርት ደግሞ ሊመክር ተቃዋሚዎቹንም ሊወቅስ ይችል ዘንድ፥ እንደተማረው በታመነ ቃል ይጽና።

verses.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.fr: Il y a, en effet, surtout parmi les circoncis, beaucoup de gens rebelles, de vains discoureurs et de séducteurs,
verses.am: የማይታዘዙና ከንቱ የሚናገሩ የሚያታልሉ ይልቁንም ከተገረዙት ወገን የሚሆኑ ብዙ ናቸውና፤

verses.en: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
verses.fr: auxquels il faut fermer la bouche. Ils bouleversent des familles entières, enseignant pour un gain honteux ce qu''on ne doit pas enseigner.
verses.am: እነዚህም ስለ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይገባውን እያስተማሩ ቤቶችን በሞላው ስለ ሚገለብጡ፥ አፋቸውን መዝጋት ይገባል።

verses.en: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, the Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.fr: L''un d''entre eux, leur propre prophète, a dit: Crétois toujours menteurs, méchantes bêtes, ventres paresseux.
verses.am: የገዛ ራሳቸው ነቢይ የሆነ ከእነርሱ አንዱ። የቀርጤስ ሰዎች ዘወትር ውሸተኞች፥ ክፉዎች አራዊት፥ በላተኞች፥ ሥራ ፈቶች ናቸው ብሎአል።

verses.en: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.fr: Ce témoignage est vrai. C''est pourquoi reprends-les sévèrement, afin qu''ils aient une foi saine,
verses.am: ሁሉ ለንጹሖች ንጹሕ ነው፤ ለርኵሳንና ለማያምኑ ግን ንጹሕ የሆነ ምንም የለም፥ ነገር ግን አእምሮአቸውም ሕሊናቸውም ረክሶአል።

verses.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.fr: et qu''ils ne s''attachent pas à des fables judaïques et à des commandements d''hommes qui se détournent de la vérité.
verses.am: ሁሉ ለንጹሖች ንጹሕ ነው፤ ለርኵሳንና ለማያምኑ ግን ንጹሕ የሆነ ምንም የለም፥ ነገር ግን አእምሮአቸውም ሕሊናቸውም ረክሶአል።

verses.en: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.fr: Tout est pur pour ceux qui sont purs; mais rien n''est pur pour ceux qui sont souillés et incrédules, leur intelligence et leur conscience sont souillées.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያውቁ በግልጥ ይናገራሉ፥ ዳሩ ግን የሚያስጸይፉና የማይታዘዙ ለበጎ ሥራም ሁሉ የማይበቁ ስለ ሆኑ፥ በሥራቸው ይክዱታል።

verses.en: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.fr: Ils font profession de connaître Dieu, mais ils le renient par leurs oeuvres, étant abominables, rebelles, et incapables d''aucune bonne oeuvre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያውቁ በግልጥ ይናገራሉ፥ ዳሩ ግን የሚያስጸይፉና የማይታዘዙ ለበጎ ሥራም ሁሉ የማይበቁ ስለ ሆኑ፥ በሥራቸው ይክዱታል።

verses.en: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.fr: Pour toi, dis les choses qui sont conformes à la saine doctrine.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ሕይወት ለሚገኝበት ትምህርት የሚገባውን ተናገር።

verses.en: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.fr: Dis que les vieillards doivent être sobres, honnêtes, modérés, sains dans la foi, dans la charité, dans la patience.
verses.am: ሽማግሌዎች ልከኞች፥ ጭምቶች፥ ራሳቸውን የሚገዙ፥ በእምነትና በፍቅር በመጽናትም ጤናሞች እንዲሆኑ ምከራቸው፤

verses.en: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.fr: Dis que les femmes âgées doivent aussi avoir l''extérieur qui convient à la sainteté, n''être ni médisantes, ni adonnées au vin; qu''elles doivent donner de bonnes instructions,
verses.am: እንዲሁም አሮጊቶች ሴቶች አካሄዳቸው ለቅዱስ አገልግሎት የሚገባ፥ የማያሙ፥ ለብዙ ወይን ጠጅ የማይገዙ፥ በጎ የሆነውን ነገር የሚያስተምሩ ይሁኑ፤

verses.en: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.fr: dans le but d''apprendre aux jeunes femmes à aimer leurs maris et leurs enfants,

verses.en: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.fr: tre retenues, chastes, occupées aux soins domestiques, bonnes, soumises à leurs maris, afin que la parole de Dieu ne soit pas blasphémée.
verses.am: ቆነጃጅትም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዳይሰደብ፥ ባሎቻቸውን የሚወዱ፥ ልጆቻቸውን የሚወዱ፥ ራሳቸውን የሚገዙ፥ ንጹሖች፥ በቤት የሚሠሩ፥ በጎዎች፥ ለባሎቻቸው የሚታዘዙ እንዲሆኑ ይምከሩአቸው።

verses.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.fr: Exhorte de même les jeunes gens à être modérés,
verses.am: ጎበዞችም እንዲሁ ራሳቸውን እንዲገዙ ምከራቸው።

verses.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.fr: te montrant toi-même à tous égards un modèle de bonnes oeuvres, et donnant un enseignement pur, digne,

verses.en: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.fr: une parole saine, irréprochable, afin que l''adversaire soit confus, n''ayant aucun mal à dire de nous.
verses.am: የሚቃወም ሰው ስለ እኛ የሚናገረውን መጥፎ ነገር ሲያጣ እንዲያፍር፥ በነገር ሁሉ መልካምን በማድረግህ ምሳሌ የሚሆን ራስህን አሳይ፤ በትምህርትህም ደኅንነትን፥ ጭምትነትን፥ ጤናማና የማይነቀፍ ንግግርን ግለጥ።

verses.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.fr: Exhorte les serviteurs à être soumis à leurs maîtres, à leur plaire en toutes choses, à n''être point contredisants,

verses.en: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.fr: ne rien dérober, mais à montrer toujours une parfaite fidélité, afin de faire honorer en tout la doctrine de Dieu notre Sauveur.
verses.am: ባሪያዎች ስለ መድኃኒታችን ስለ እግዚአብሔር የሚሆነውን ትምህርት በሁሉ ነገር ያስመሰግኑ ዘንድ፥ ለገዛ ጌቶቻቸው እንዲገዙ በሁሉም ደስ እንዲያሰኙ፥ ሳይቃወሙና ሳይሰርቁም በጎ ታማኝነትን ሁሉ እንዲያሳዩ ምከራቸው።

verses.en: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.fr: Car la grâce de Dieu, source de salut pour tous les hommes, a été manifestée.
verses.am: ሰዎችን ሁሉ የሚያድን የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ተገልጦአልና፤

verses.en: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.fr: Elle nous enseigne à renoncer à l''impiété et aux convoitises mondaines, et à vivre dans le siècle présent selon la sagesse, la justice et la piété,
verses.am: መድኃኒታችንም ከዓመፅ ሁሉ እንዲቤዠን፥ መልካሙንም ለማድረግ የሚቀናውን ገንዘቡም የሚሆነውን ሕዝብ ለራሱ እንዲያነጻ፥ ስለ እኛ ነፍሱን ሰጥቶአል።

verses.en: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.fr: en attendant la bienheureuse espérance, et la manifestation de la gloire du grand Dieu et de notre Sauveur Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: መድኃኒታችንም ከዓመፅ ሁሉ እንዲቤዠን፥ መልካሙንም ለማድረግ የሚቀናውን ገንዘቡም የሚሆነውን ሕዝብ ለራሱ እንዲያነጻ፥ ስለ እኛ ነፍሱን ሰጥቶአል።

verses.en: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.fr: qui s''est donné lui-même pour nous, afin de nous racheter de toute iniquité, et de se faire un peuple qui lui appartienne, purifié par lui et zélé pour les bonnes oeuvres.
verses.am: ይህን በሙሉ ሥልጣን ተናገርና ምከር ገሥጽም፤ ማንም አይናቅህ።

verses.en: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.fr: Dis ces choses, exhorte, et reprends, avec une pleine autorité. Que personne ne te méprise.
verses.am: ይህን በሙሉ ሥልጣን ተናገርና ምከር ገሥጽም፤ ማንም አይናቅህ።

verses.en: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.fr: Rappelle-leur d''être soumis aux magistrats et aux autorités, d''obéir, d''être prêts à toute bonne oeuvre,
verses.am: ለገዦችና ለባለ ሥልጣኖች የሚገዙና የሚታዘዙ፥ ለበጎ ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጁ፥ ማንንም የማይሰድቡ፥

verses.en: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.fr: de ne médire de personne, d''être pacifiques, modérés, pleins de douceur envers tous les hommes.
verses.am: የማይከራከሩ፥ ገሮች፥ ለሰው ሁሉ የዋህነትን ሁሉ የሚያሳዩ እንዲሆኑ ኣሳስባቸው።

verses.en: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.fr: Car nous aussi, nous étions autrefois insensés, désobéissants, égarés, asservis à toute espèce de convoitises et de voluptés, vivant dans la méchanceté et dans l''envie, dignes d''être haïs, et nous haïssant les uns les autres.
verses.am: እኛ ደግሞ አስቀድመን የማናስተውል ነበርንና፤ የማንታዘዝ፥ የምንስት፥ ለምኞትና ለልዩ ልዩ ተድላ እንደ ባሪያዎች የምንገዛ፥ በክፋትና በምቀኝነት የምንኖር፥ የምንጣላ፥ እርስ በርሳችን የምንጠላላ ነበርን።

verses.en: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.fr: Mais, lorsque la bonté de Dieu notre Sauveur et son amour pour les hommes ont été manifestés,
verses.am: ነገር ግን የመድኃኒታችን የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነትና ሰውን መውደዱ በተገለጠ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.fr: il nous a sauvés, non à cause des oeuvres de justice que nous aurions faites, mais selon sa miséricorde, par le baptême de la régénération et le renouvellement du Saint-Esprit,
verses.am: እንደ ምሕረቱ መጠን ለአዲስ ልደት በሚሆነው መታጠብና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በመታደስ አዳነን እንጂ፥ እኛ ስላደረግነው በጽድቅ ስለ ነበረው ሥራ አይደለም፤

verses.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
verses.fr: qu''il a répandu sur nous avec abondance par Jésus-Christ notre Sauveur,

verses.en: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.fr: afin que, justifiés par sa grâce, nous devenions, en espérance, héritiers de la vie éternelle.
verses.am: ያን መንፈስም፥ በጸጋው ጸድቀን በዘላለም ሕይወት ተስፋ ወራሾች እንድንሆን፥ በመድኃኒታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በእኛ ላይ አትርፎ አፈሰሰው።

verses.en: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.fr: Cette parole est certaine, et je veux que tu affirmes ces choses, afin que ceux qui ont cru en Dieu s''appliquent à pratiquer de bonnes oeuvres. Voilà ce qui est bon et utile aux hommes.
verses.am: ቃሉ የታመነ ነው። እግዚአብሔርንም የሚያምኑት በመልካም ሥራ በጥንቃቄ እንዲጸኑ፥ እነዚህን አስረግጠህ እንድትናገር እፈቅዳለሁ። ይህ መልካምና ለሰዎች የሚጠቅም ነው፤

verses.en: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.fr: Mais évite les discussions folles, les généalogies, les querelles, les disputes relatives à la loi; car elles sont inutiles et vaines.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሞኝነት ካለው ምርመራና ከትውልዶች ታሪክ ከክርክርም ስለ ሕግም ከሚሆን ጠብ ራቅ፤ የማይጠቅሙና ከንቱዎች ናቸውና፤

verses.en: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.fr: Eloigne de toi, après un premier et un second avertissement, celui qui provoque des divisions,
verses.am: አርጢሞንን ወይም ቲኪቆስን ወደ አንተ ስልክ፥ ወደ ኒቆጵልዮን ወደ እኔ እንድትመጣ ትጋ፤ በዚያ ልከርም ቈርጬአለሁና።

verses.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.fr: sachant qu''un homme de cette espèce est perverti, et qu''il pèche, en se condamnant lui-même.
verses.am: አርጢሞንን ወይም ቲኪቆስን ወደ አንተ ስልክ፥ ወደ ኒቆጵልዮን ወደ እኔ እንድትመጣ ትጋ፤ በዚያ ልከርም ቈርጬአለሁና።

verses.en: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.fr: Lorsque je t''enverrai Artémas ou Tychique, hâte-toi de venir me rejoindre à Nicopolis; car c''est là que j''ai résolu de passer l''hiver.
verses.am: ሕግ አዋቂውን ዜማስንና አጵሎስን ምንም እንዳይጎድልባቸው በጉዞአቸው ተግተህ እርዳ።

verses.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.fr: Aie soin de pourvoir au voyage de Zénas, le docteur de la loi, et d''Apollos, en sorte que rien ne leur manque.
verses.am: ከወገናችንም ያሉት ደግሞ ፍሬ ቢሶች ሆነው እንዳይቀሩ፥ የግድ ስለሚያስፈልገው ነገር በመልካም ሥራ እንዲጸኑ ይማሩ።

verses.en: And let our's also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.fr: Il faut que les nôtres aussi apprennent à pratiquer de bonnes oeuvres pour subvenir aux besoins pressants, afin qu''ils ne soient pas sans produire des fruits.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ያሉት ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡልሃል። በእምነት ለሚወዱን ሰላምታ አቅርብልን። ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui sont avec moi te saluent. Salue ceux qui nous aiment dans la foi. Que la grâce soit avec vous tous!
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ያሉት ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡልሃል። በእምነት ለሚወዱን ሰላምታ አቅርብልን። ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
